component.name: Ezoo Download
component.summary: Download manager for HTTP, HLS, DASH, video and torrents
مدير تحميلات يدعم HTTP و HLS و DASH والفيديو والتورنت

description.p: Ezoo Download is a desktop download manager written in Rust with a Slint interface. It splits files over up to 32 connections, resumes after an interruption, and keeps running next to the clock when its window is closed.
Ezoo Download مدير تحميلات مكتوب بلغة Rust بواجهة Slint: يقسّم الملف على عدة اتصالات، يستأنف بعد الانقطاع، ويبقى بجوار الساعة عند إغلاق النافذة.

ul.li: Video and audio from the browser through its extension
Torrents and magnets (aria2), video sites via yt-dlp
System tray, queues, scheduler, speed limits, site grabber
Eight languages, right-to-left interface in Arabic
The Linux packages bundle a static ffmpeg

description.p: Linux packaging: .deb, .rpm, AppImage and Flatpak, each with a bundled ffmpeg; the desktop draws the window frame.
